Nomura and Credit Suisse also warned of large losses.

corrected_claim: On 22 April 2020 Facebook invested $5.7 billion (about Rs 43,574 crore) for a 9.99% stake in Reliance Jio Platforms - the largest FDI in India's tech sector; the deal lifted Reliance Industries shares sharply (about 10% intraday move reported) and supported the broader market, which had been trading in the 9,000-9,500 Nifty zone.

evidence.title: Facebook takes 9.99% stake in Reliance Jio at Rs 43,574 crore

notes: Exact deal value is $5.7B / Rs 43,574 crore (claim rounded to $6B / Rs 45,000 crore); RIL intraday gain 'about 10%' per contemporaneous coverage.

corrected_claim: China's regulatory crackdown on tech and education companies triggered a two-day Hang Seng rout: HSI fell 4.13% on 26 July 2021 and 4.22% on 27 July 2021 (combined about 8.2% close-to-close, ~9%+ peak-to-trough); the Hang Seng Tech index fell roughly 7% on 27 July; the China Enterprises index (HSCE) fell 4.9% and 5.1% on the two days.

evidence.title: Yahoo Finance ^HSI daily closes: 26,192.3 (26 Jul) and 25,086.4 (27 Jul 2021)
Hong Kong's Hang Seng index closes more than 4% down as China tech and education shares plunge

notes: Claim's 'over 5% on 27 Jul' applies to HSCE (-5.08%), not HSI (-4.22%); combined ~8.2% close-to-close.
